name: luxbnb
description: LuxBnB Guesty plugins. Install this repo only (cjam28/luxbnb-claude-plugins).

plugins.name: luxbnb-guesty
plugins.description: Guesty assistant for the LuxBnB property-management team: reservations, calendar, inbox, tasks, and scheduled reports. Get started: (1) Work inside a Cowork Project — not a loose chat. (2) Connect the LuxBnB Guesty connector if tools are missing (see this repo's README). (3) In that project chat, run /luxbnb-guesty:setup (guesty-onboarding). (4) Then run /luxbnb-guesty:interview (interview-and-dashboard-setup) in the same chat to build reports. (5) Pin that chat and return there for system changes. Drop statements and contracts under reports/statements/ and reports/contracts/ in the project, not only in the chat.
